terms.definition: No lie; I'm being completely serious.
terms.example: That movie was incredible, no cap.
terms.translation: I'm not exaggerating — that movie was genuinely incredible.

terms.definition: A lie; to lie or exaggerate.
terms.example: Stop capping, you were never there.
terms.translation: Stop lying — you weren't there.

terms.definition: Okay; agreement; sounds good; confirmed.
terms.example: Can you pick me up at 5? — Bet.
terms.translation: Can you pick me up at 5? — Sure, will do.

terms.definition: To do something exceptionally well; to look amazing.
terms.example: She absolutely slayed that presentation.
terms.translation: She absolutely nailed that presentation.

terms.definition: Really good, especially referring to food.
terms.example: These tacos are bussin.
terms.translation: These tacos are absolutely delicious.

terms.definition: For real; seriously; I mean it.
terms.example: That homework was impossible fr.
terms.translation: That homework was genuinely impossible, I'm serious.

terms.definition: Natural charm or charisma, especially romantic appeal.
terms.example: He walked in and immediately rizzed her up.
terms.translation: He walked in and immediately charmed her.

terms.definition: Mediocre; average; not impressive.
terms.example: The sequel was mid compared to the original.
terms.translation: The sequel was just okay — nothing special compared to the original.

terms.definition: Suspicious; sketchy; shady.
terms.example: Why are you being so sus about where you were?
terms.translation: Why are you being so secretive about where you were?

terms.definition: Secretly; somewhat; quietly; on the down-low.
terms.example: I lowkey love that old TV show.
terms.translation: I secretly love that old TV show, though I don't usually admit it.

terms.definition: Very much; obviously; openly; intensely.
terms.example: I highkey want pizza right now.
terms.translation: I really, obviously want pizza right now.

terms.definition: Greatest Of All Time.
terms.example: She's the GOAT at this game.
terms.translation: She's the best player ever at this game.

terms.definition: Confident, admirable; not caring what others think; holding a respected opinion.
terms.example: Wearing whatever you want regardless of trends is so based.
terms.translation: Being confident and wearing whatever you want, regardless of trends, is really admirable.

terms.definition: Gossip; drama; the truth about a situation.
terms.example: Spill the tea — what happened at the party?
terms.translation: Tell me everything — what happened at the party?

terms.definition: A feeling or atmosphere; to relax and enjoy the moment.
terms.example: We were just vibing at the beach all day.
terms.translation: We were just relaxing and having a good time at the beach all day.

terms.definition: An assessment of someone's attitude or energy; a test of whether someone fits in.
terms.example: He failed the vibe check immediately.
terms.translation: His attitude was off right away — he didn't fit the energy of the group.

terms.definition: An obsessive fan; to be an intense fan of something or someone.
terms.example: I stan that band so hard — I've seen them 12 times.
terms.translation: I'm a huge dedicated fan of that band — I've seen them 12 times.

terms.definition: Acting as if you're the star of your own movie; self-centered but in a confident, aspirational way.
terms.example: She walked in like she was the main character.
terms.translation: She walked in with total confidence, like everything was about her.

aliases: living in my head rent free
terms.definition: Something that keeps coming back to your mind without effort.
terms.example: That song is living in my head rent free.
terms.translation: I can't stop thinking about that song.

terms.definition: Suddenly cutting off all contact with someone without explanation.
terms.example: They were texting every day and then he just ghosted her.
terms.translation: They were texting every day and then he suddenly stopped all contact without explanation.

terms.definition: A romantic relationship that exists without a clear label or commitment.
terms.example: They've been in a situationship for six months now.
terms.translation: They've been romantically involved but haven't defined the relationship for six months.

terms.definition: In the early romantic stage before officially dating.
terms.example: Are they dating? No, they're just talking.
terms.translation: Are they dating? No, they're in the early flirting / getting-to-know-you stage.

terms.definition: Bitter, upset, or resentful about something.
terms.example: He's still salty about losing the game.
terms.translation: He's still upset and resentful about losing the game.

terms.definition: A highly relatable feeling or situation.
terms.example: Wanting to nap all day is such a mood.
terms.translation: Wanting to nap all day is something I completely relate to.

terms.definition: Excellent; amazing; impressive.
terms.example: Your outfit is fire today.
terms.translation: Your outfit looks amazing today.

terms.definition: A loss or failure; embarrassment.
terms.example: He took a big L asking her out in front of everyone.
terms.translation: It was really embarrassing when he asked her out in front of everyone.

terms.definition: A win; a success; something positive.
terms.example: Getting tickets to that show was a massive W.
terms.translation: Getting tickets to that show was a huge win.

terms.definition: When a reply gets more likes than the original post — meaning people agree with the response more than the original.
terms.example: That tweet got ratioed into oblivion.
terms.translation: People overwhelmingly disagreed with that tweet — the replies had way more likes.

terms.definition: Close friends; people you consider family.
terms.example: These are my fam — we've known each other forever.
terms.translation: These are my closest friends — we've known each other forever.

terms.definition: Completely serious; absolutely; for real.
terms.example: I deadass forgot your birthday, I'm so sorry.
terms.translation: I genuinely and completely forgot your birthday — I'm so sorry.

terms.definition: Has a unique, often stronger emotional effect than usual.
terms.example: This song hits different at 2am.
terms.translation: This song feels more emotional and meaningful late at night.

terms.definition: Perfectly executed what was expected; did exactly the right thing.
terms.example: Her costume was flawless — she understood the assignment.
terms.translation: Her costume was perfect — she delivered exactly what the moment called for.

terms.definition: Acceptance of something unfortunate that can't be changed.
terms.example: I didn't get the shift I wanted — it is what it is.
terms.translation: I didn't get the shift I wanted, but there's nothing I can do about it.

terms.definition: Stylish outfit or accessories; fashionable appearance.
terms.example: His drip at the event was unmatched.
terms.translation: His outfit and style at the event was better than everyone else's.

terms.definition: To show off; to brag about something.
terms.example: Posting that vacation photo was such a flex.
terms.translation: Posting that vacation photo was really showing off.

terms.definition: Go outside; stop being so consumed by the internet.
terms.example: You've been online for 10 hours — go touch grass.
terms.translation: You've been on the internet for 10 hours — go outside and get some fresh air.

terms.definition: A dismissive response to an out-of-touch or old-fashioned opinion.
terms.example: You think email is still the best way to reach people? OK boomer.
terms.translation: You think email is the best way to reach people? That's an old-fashioned view.

terms.definition: End of discussion; that's final; emphasizes a statement as undeniable.
terms.example: She's the best candidate for the job, periodt.
terms.translation: She's the best candidate for the job, and that's final — no debate.

terms.definition: A distinct phase or period in someone's life defined by a particular identity or attitude.
terms.example: I'm in my self-care era right now.
terms.translation: I'm currently focused on taking care of myself and my wellbeing.

terms.definition: Delusional; having unrealistic expectations, often about a romantic interest.
terms.example: She thinks he likes her back — she's so delulu.
terms.translation: She thinks he likes her back — she's being completely unrealistic.

terms.definition: Non-Player Character — someone who acts robotically, follows the crowd, or lacks independent thought.
terms.example: He just goes along with whatever everyone else says — total NPC.
terms.translation: He just goes along with whatever everyone else says without thinking for himself.

terms.definition: Caught doing something wrong with undeniable proof; busted with clear evidence.
terms.example: She was caught in 4K lying about being sick.
terms.translation: She was caught with absolute proof — there's no denying she lied about being sick.
